messages:
sarah.dev: Scheduling tf apply for release-2026.03 in tonight's 21:00-22:00 UTC change window. Plan: split tfstate (tenant-vpc), routing canary at 10%, and IAM pin updates. Need thumbs + canary owner.

sarah.dev: plan snippet:
```bash
terraform plan -var 'canary_percent=10' -var 'tfstate_split=true' -out canary.plan
```

raj-infra: Quick asks: pin provider aws to 4.12.0 (4.13 caused drift last cycle). Also we should tag the new backend with `rollback_tag = \"release-2026-03-canary\"`.

raj-infra: provider snippet:
```hcl
provider \"aws\" {
  version = \"~> 4.12.0\"
}
```

eva-sre: :wave: Can we gate the canary behind deploybot and circuit-breaker? If error rate >5% for 5m, auto-rollback. Also add an egress sanity check before we move traffic.

eva-sre: rollback command if needed:
`/deploybot rollback 6000004321 --reason \"canary regen fail\"`

deploybot: deploybot: Scheduled apply request received for thread 6000004321. Queued workspaces: tenant-vpc, routing. Locks will be acquired at start time. Runbook: `/deploybot status 6000004321` and `/deploybot rollback <run-id>` for rollbacks.

tim-release: Please add one-line release note: \"Split tfstate for tenant isolation; canary at 10%; aws provider pinned to 4.12.0\" — I'll include it in the release draft.

raj-infra: +1 on provider pin. I'll do a dry-run now and post plan output (`canary.plan`) in ~30m.

sarah.dev: thanks. pushed `scripts/check-egress.sh` in the PR — it validates NAT gateway routes and known egress IPs. tagging @eva-sre for quick review.

eva-sre: reviewing now. Also add these routing defaults in the module:
```hcl
module \"routing\" {
  max_failed_requests = 100
  auto_rollback = true
}
```

deploybot: Preflight checks: tenant-vpc ok, backend reachable, state snapshot present. Lock acquired for tenant-vpc and routing. ETA apply start: 2026-03-21T21:05:00Z. To abort before start: `/deploybot cancel 6000004321`.

sarah.dev: Final plan: start 21:05 UTC, canary 10% for 10 minutes, progressive shift on success. If rollback triggered we will restore to previous tfstate snapshot `s3://redwood-tfstate/backups/6000004321.tar.gz` and revert infra module versions (restore tag `release-2026-03-canary`). Thanks all — will post live status in this thread. :thumbsup:
